title: events/types/retry.checkpoint.saved
description: Payload for event_type 'retry.checkpoint.saved' (native type, feature 003; FR-205/FR-206): the namespaced checkpoint save the loop returns to on failure. Emitted once per run after game.save and list_saves verification.

run_id.description: Retry-loop run identifier; run.* kind per common/id grammar.

checkpoint_id.description: Logical checkpoint identifier for this run (cp<N>).

save_name.description: Namespaced save name passed to game.save, '<family>--<run_id>--cp<N>'.

family.description: Checkpoint save family (isolation prefix) from the retry config.
